name: MailFlow-frontend
description: Browser interface for MailFlow, a self-hosted webmail client for existing IMAP/SMTP accounts. Serves the React application through nginx and proxies API/WebSocket requests to the configured backend address and port. HTTPS uses a generated self-signed certificate unless you provide cert.pem and key.pem. HTTP is intended for a trusted TLS-terminating reverse proxy.

paths.name: TLS certificate storage
paths.description: Persistent writable certificate directory. Supply cert.pem and key.pem, or the container generates a self-signed pair at startup.

ports.name: HTTPS web interface
ports.description: Host HTTPS port. Change if occupied; the WebUI link follows this mapping.

ports.name: HTTP reverse-proxy port
ports.description: Host HTTP port for a TLS-terminating reverse proxy. Forward X-Forwarded-Proto: https. Restrict access appropriately.

variables.name: Backend host address
variables.description: Required: Unraid host IPv4 address or resolvable hostname where the backend port is published. Do not use localhost or the backend container name with default bridge networking.

variables.name: Backend port
variables.description: Required: backend mapped host port, default 3220. Must match Backend API host port in the backend template, not its internal port 3000.

variables.name: Application URL
variables.description: Optional frontend compatibility setting: use the same browser-facing URL as backend APP_URL. Frontend consumption is not yet verified; this does not replace the required backend URL settings.
